b8e87b0b6170501ac8d9.en: Newtalk news (Central News Agency reporter Wang Shufen, Taipei, 14th) In recent years, the damage to crops caused by monkey pests has become more and more serious. Agriculture Minister Chen Junji answered in the Legislative Yuan today that the Legislative Yuan proposed amendments to the Agricultural Development Ordinance during the last session of the Legislative Yuan. The Ministry of Agriculture has agreed to include agricultural damage caused by wildlife in natural disasters. The Legislative Yuan Economic Committee today arranged for Chen Junji to report on the business of the Ministry of Agriculture. Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) legislators Guo Guowen and Wu Lihua are concerned about the serious problem of monkey damage causing agricultural losses. Guo Guowen said that extreme climate diseases, pests, and wildlife hazards have forced some farmers away from agriculture, and the planting area has continued to shrink. In particular, wildlife hazards have gradually spread from mountainous areas to flatlands, and even have a tendency to continue to spread to a wider area. The situation is becoming more and more serious, Ng Lihua said. Many farmers have petitioned her. The monkey pest problem is not a sporadic case, which has caused serious agriculture in many places.
